actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.KnowledgeServices.get#History').parameter('wikiPageId', wikiPageId || '').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {versionList: out.versionList, canRestore: out.canRestore})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.KnowledgeServices.create#Note').parameters({title: title || null, pageText: pageText || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {wikiPageId: out.wikiPageId, pagePath: out.pagePath})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.KnowledgeServices.set#PageTags').parameters({wikiPageId: wikiPageId || '', tags: tags || ''}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {tagList: out.tagList})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.KnowledgeServices.restore#Version').parameters({wikiPageId: wikiPageId || '', versionName: versionName || ''}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {newVersionName: out.newVersionName, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.l10n.localize('Restored as the newest version')}]})
